description_sq:
Ne zonen e Kinostudios ne rrugen Kongresi Manastirit ofrohet apartament 2+1 per shitje.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 pa ashensor te nje ndertimi relativisht te ri te vitit 2000.
Sip. totale e apartamentit e shkelur eshte 65 m2 nga te cilat 50m2 jane ne certifikate pronese.
Organizimi i apartamentit ndahet ne: korridor shperndares, dy dhoma gjumi, sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi, nje tualet, ballkon.
Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug cka mundeson diell dhe ndricim gjate pjeses me te madhe te dites.
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion ose shoqerim ne prone lutemi te na kontaktoni
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale in the Kinostudio area on Kongresi Manastirit street. The apartment is located on the 4th floor without elevator of a relatively new building from 2000. Sip. the total of the violated apartment is 65 m2, of which 50 m2 are in the certificate of ownership. The organization of the apartment is divided into: distribution corridor, two bedrooms, living room with kitchen area, a toilet, balcony. The orientation of the apartment is south, which allows sun and light during most of the day. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or assistance in the property, please contact us
